Training Plan update · Complete POC v3.3 · 3 October 2026

A Training Plan defines how a particular training program will be conducted. This update retains v3.1 registration and v3.2 resource functionality while adding day-wise plan review, automatic unique codes and explicit historical-change controls.

Workflow and screens

Training plans → Add Training Plan → select project → enter name → choose type → description → training days → validate/save → generated code. View day schedule shows each day’s activity note and linked resources/forms. Assign resources/forms → choose resource → select one or more day checkboxes → save. Day activities edits optional training notes for unused plans. Change assigned days updates unused plan links, including plan-wide materials that were not day-assigned.

For a used plan: structural and existing day changes are blocked with a clear reason. Modify Plan permits audited name/description edits with change reason. Create revised plan copies the original plan and links into a new independently editable plan with a new code. Existing batches keep original plan IDs/codes. New resources may explicitly reach existing batches under the retained v3.2 per-link review decision; additions are audited and day assignments require a reason when including existing batches. There is no automatic revision activation or historical reassignment.

Supplied example

DayActivity
Day 1Pre-assessment + Training
Day 2Training + Learning Resources
Day 3Training + Learning Resources
Day 4Post-assessment + Feedback

Create 4-day example lets the reviewer select a project and save a separate SAMPLE Digital Teaching – Induction plan with the above notes and linked synthetic forms/resources. It has its own generated code and changes no existing batch.

Business clarification required

Confirm editor/approval roles; description mandatory status and field limits; code format and uniqueness scope; upper duration limits/calendar mapping; exact historical-change approval/versioning/removal/rollback policy; whether revisions retain a business-level plan code; treatment of completed batches when resources are added. No plan deletion is introduced because no deletion requirement or policy was supplied.

Prototype assumptions and suggested UX improvements

Positive whole-number duration, global UUID-derived codes, central Admin editor, independent revised plan/new code, metadata change reasons and blocking started/registered batch reassignment are temporary controls. Optional day notes, per-day quick assign, checkbox day selection and a clearly labelled sample generator are UX improvements. New revisions are saved immediately as independent records; they are not silently attached to old batches. Every day need not have a linked resource unless business confirms that rule.

Verification and limits

39 new Training Plan rules/action assertions passed in a non-browser fixture, covering multiple plans per project, type/duration validation, unique codes, multi-day links, out-of-range rejection, duration reduction, unused-link edits, historical locks/reasons/audit, revised plan isolation and sample schedule. Existing registration/resource and rendering checks passed. Browser visual/responsive and actual IndexedDB checks remain unverified. Server must enforce roles/project ACLs, unique codes, historical plan/version controls and immutable auditing.
